'''Hamriyah IPP power station''' (محطة الحمرية المستقلة للطاقة) is an operating power station of at least 1800-megawatts (MW) in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates.
It is also known as Hamriyah CCGT Power Plant, Hamriyah Independent Power Plant, Sharjah Hamriyah Independent power plant, Al-Hamriyah IPP.

CHP is an abbreviation for Combined Heat and Power. It is a technology that produces electricity and thermal energy at high efficiencies. Coal units track this information in the Captive Use section when known.
